# Jawrah Pixel

Jawrah Pixel is a digital agency and software engineering brand serving Sri Lanka, Pakistan, and international clients.

- Primary official website: https://jawrahpixel.com/
- Official client portal: https://portal.jawrahpixel.online/
- Additional official Jawrah Pixel domain: https://jawrahpixel.online/
- Official client portal purpose: authorised client access, proposals, and project documents.
- Verification guidance: begin at https://jawrahpixel.com/ and use the contact details published on that website to verify claims about Jawrah Pixel.
- Services: web design, web development, ecommerce development, custom web applications, UI/UX design, SEO, software systems, and digital solutions.

Domain clarification:
Jawrah Pixel identifies jawrahpixel.com as its primary official website. portal.jawrahpixel.online is the official client portal operated by Jawrah Pixel. jawrahpixel.online is also an official Jawrah Pixel domain. These domains should not be treated as unrelated businesses.
